layernorm.test:
def run_additional_tests():
    # 1. Single element per row (extreme boundary)
    check(1, 1)
    # 2. N just below BLOCK_SIZE (tail handling in first/only block)
    check(1, 1023)
    # 3. N just above BLOCK_SIZE (tail handling in last block)
    check(1, 1025)
    # 4. Multiple rows with N not a multiple of BLOCK_SIZE
    check(10, 1000)
    # 5. Constant input (variance = 0) with large magnitude -> tests eps handling and numerical stability
    M, N = 4, 256
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.full((M, N), 1e4)  # constant large value
    w = torch.rand(N)
    b = torch.rand(N)
    ref = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(x, (N,), w, b, 1e-5)
    out = layer_norm(x, w, b, 1e-5)
    assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=1e-2, rtol=0), "constant large input mismatch"
    # 6. Very small epsilon (tests division stability when variance is tiny)
    check(4, 256, eps=1e-12)

run_additional_tests()
